briefs.prompt: A living knot with one persistent internal void. It should slowly inhale and twist without collapsing into a ring or flower.
A dense asymmetric braid that drifts rather than spins as one rigid body. Preserve several visible crossings and uneven lobe sizes over time.
A compact turbulent skein with a clear hollow center and a slow phase reversal. It should feel unstable locally but stable as a whole.
definingRelationships: slow phase reversal without global collapse

briefs.prompt: A stretched recurrent loop whose two ends appear to exchange mass over time. Keep an elongated silhouette and at least one durable interior crossing.
A three-lobed recurrent tangle with uneven lobes and a subtle precession. Avoid radial symmetry and preserve the lobe relationships through motion.
A sparse looping recurrence that repeatedly opens and nearly closes a central gap without ever becoming a simple circle.
A long axial ribbon carrying a traveling fold from left to right. It should remain unmistakably one-dimensional and taper toward both ends.
A thin filament with two coupled waves moving at different rates, producing knots of interference that migrate along the axis.
A folded ribbon with a quiet center and active ends: the terminal regions should oscillate more strongly while the middle remains comparatively restrained.
A serpentine filament whose main wave travels forward while a finer ripple travels backward, producing a changing woven edge without becoming a closed loop.
A sparse lightning-like ribbon that bends sharply but continuously. A slow pulse should move through the bends without creating discontinuities.
A broad S-shaped filament with a narrow waist that moves along the body. Keep the overall S identity while the local constriction travels.
definingRelationships: global silhouette persists while local width changes
